title: Google published a PoC exploit for CVE-2026-74127, a critical CVSS 9.4 AMD PSP Code Execution flaw and Masterkey CVE-2018-8930 variant on Ze
content_md:
Google published a PoC exploit for CVE-2026-74127, a critical CVSS 9.4 AMD PSP Code Execution flaw and Masterkey CVE-2018-8930 variant on Ze

via Mastodon https://securityonline.info/cve-2026-74127-amd-psp-code-execution-poc/?utm_source=mastodon&utm_medium=jetpack_social

CVE-2026-74127.evidence: The post reports that Google published a proof-of-concept exploit for the AMD PSP code execution flaw, with no claim of exploitation in the wild.
